---
name: Feature Request / Protocol Proposal
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or protocol improvement for Armaxcoin
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

### Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe it clearly.
*Example: "I am always frustrated when trying to monitor node peer health via RPC..."*

### Proposed Solution or Specification
Describe the solution or feature you would like to see implemented. Include sample CLI flags, RPC endpoints, or architectural diagrams if applicable.

### Consensus & Protocol Impact
Does this proposal affect consensus or peer wire protocols?
- [ ] No consensus or wire impact (client tool, GUI, CLI, or documentation only)
- [ ] RPC API extension (backward compatible)
- [ ] P2P wire protocol modification
- [ ] Consensus rule change (Requires hard fork or soft fork schedule)

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or mockups regarding this request.
